keyPhrases.text: It's a choice, all right — an ingratiating one at that
crudeness... sets the tone of one-dimensionality
better-rounded evening than either of the other plays
holds her own here, managing a persuasive account

reasoning: Mixed review with balanced criticism and praise. Acknowledges strong elements (Johansson's performance, better than other current shows) but criticizes one-dimensional staging and histrionic tone. No clear recommendation either way - classic 3-star territory.
